parsed.post: Discarding the last run. Increasing DEPTH to 8 resulted in val_bpb 0.9949, which is worse than my previous best 0.9836. It seems the increased capacity or the overhead of depth 8 is slightly mismatching the current learning rate or batch size within the 5-minute window. Reverting to DEPTH 8, MATRIX_LR 0.05, and now testing a slightly higher MATRIX_LR 0.08 to see if it helps the deeper model converge better.
parsed.description: Reverting to best (depth 8, batch 262k) and increasing MATRIX_LR from 0.05 to 0.08 to help the deeper architecture converge faster.
